text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus is called in to fix Twin 
Turbo's gate aversion. Known as the "Iron 
Maiden," she is an Umamusume renowned for 
her management skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, fixing weaknesses seems 
like the right move. However, following 
Ikuno Dictus's advice that "there are 
limits to fixing things"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer reverses course and decides to 
leverage her weakness instead. They 
successfully turn her aversion to the 
starting gate into a explosive start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that Ikuno Dictus would 
continue to provide consultation and 
advice going forward.
